containers.name: postgres
args:
set -eu
if [ ! -s "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  until PGPASSWORD="$REPLICATION_PASSWORD" pg_basebackup \
      -h records-db.health-phi.svc.cluster.local -U replicator \
      -D "$PGDATA" -R -X stream; do
    echo "base backup failed, retrying"; rm -rf "$PGDATA"; sleep 5
  done
  chmod 0700 "$PGDATA"
fi
exec postgres -c hot_standby=on
